Germany’s Budget: Hospitals on the Block, Arms on the Rise

Germany just put numbers on its real priorities. Under Merz’s government, hospital funding is being cut by roughly €6.9 billion over the coming years through the latest round of “hospital reform adjustments” and GKV savings, while the system is already under strain from years of closures, understaffing, and consolidation. 

Doctors and hospital staff are striking or preparing warning strikes across the country over pay, overwork, and collapsing conditions, but Berlin’s answer is more restructuring jargon and less money in the system.

At the same time, the German arms industry is saying the quiet part out loud. Leading defense lobbyists are demanding a “Rüstungsbeschleunigungsgesetz” — a legal fast‑track to subsidize and speed up weapons investment — if Germany is serious about becoming “kriegstüchtig” (ready for war) by 2029, as the government itself has declared. 

They want state‑backed financing, special regulatory treatment, and for their products (minus banned categories like anti‑personnel mines) to be classed as “sustainable” in EU banking and reporting rules. In other words: hospitals get told to tighten belts; defense firms demand to be treated like the green transition.

Merz’s coalition dresses this up as modernization: fewer, more specialized clinics, supposedly higher quality, “relief” for statutory insurance via special funds while the health sector absorbs cuts and slower investment. 

But the practical effect is clear to anyone outside a Berlin committee room. Rural areas lose local hospitals or see them downgraded, staff burn out and walk, and patients travel further for care in a system that’s been told again and again to “bundle services” and “reduce capacities.” 

Meanwhile, the one area where “capacity expansion” is non‑negotiable is defense: more shells, more systems, more plants — on terms written largely by industry.

Germany has spent years telling itself it can be a social state at home and a reluctant power abroad. 

The new budget logic says otherwise. When you cut billions from hospitals and then promise tens of billions for rearmament, you are not just shifting line items — you are rewriting the social contract. 

The doctors on strike understand it perfectly: their wards are being asked to die a little so the country’s war economy can live a lot.

❗️ Hut 8 Leases AI Infrastructure for $9.8 Billion

🌟 Hut 8 has announced the launch of the first phase of its AI campus, Beacon Point, in Texas. The company has signed a 15-year lease agreement for 352 MW of infrastructure with a base contract value of $9.8 billion, which could extend up to $25.1 billion if all renewal options are exercised. The lessee is an unnamed organization with a high investment rating, planning to use the computing power for large-scale AI model training and inference tasks.

📌 The facility will be built according to NVIDIA DGX architecture standards for gigawatt-level infrastructure. Beacon Point is Hut 8's second AI campus following River Bend, and it operates on an "energy first" model. The company first secures the site and grid connections before entering into lease agreements with clients.

📈 Following this deal, Hut 8's total contracted AI data center capacity has increased to 597 MW, with a combined base contract value of approximately $16.8 billion and an expected average annual net operating income of $1.1 billion. The Beacon Point facility has a total capacity of up to 1 GW, with 352 MW of IT capacity currently commercialized requiring about 500 MW of electricity. The remaining capacity can be used for future project expansions.

Желание погладить котика обернулось для 5-летнего ребёнка операцией на руке — у малышки началось гнойное воспаление кисти.

Как рассказали «Базе», всё произошло с девочкой по имени Теона в подъезде её дома в Барнауле. Там она заметила одинокого кота и захотела погладить «бедняжку». Однако тот испугался и вцепился клыками в левую руку. Дома мама обработала рану, но состояние дочки лишь ухудшилось: кисть сильно опухла, а температура поднялась до 39,5.

В травмпункте ребёнку сделали прививку от бешенства, но отёк не спадал. Родители отвезли девочку в больницу, где хирурги уже поставили диагноз «флегмона левой кисти» и прооперировали ребёнка — вскрыли руку, удалили гной и поставили дренаж. 

Сейчас рана малышки затянулась. Однако, по словам мамы, эта история ничему дочку не научила. Теона по-прежнему хочет погладить каждого встречного кота и других животных.
